backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken immediately before this apply
backup.production_rule: Expand only: two new read functions, public.concierge_conversations_v1(int) and public.concierge_thread_v1(text), both security definer with an empty search_path, granted to authenticated only and refusing anyone who is not an active owner or admin. No table, column, policy or data change; concierge_threads stays closed to every client role. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs does it). Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: both_functions_exist_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('concierge_conversations_v1','concierge_thread_v1')

forward_verification.name: grants_authenticated_only_anon_and_public_none
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.concierge_conversations_v1(int)','execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.concierge_thread_v1(text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.concierge_conversations_v1(int)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.concierge_thread_v1(text)','execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid in ('public.concierge_conversations_v1(int)'::regprocedure,'public.concierge_thread_v1(text)'::regprocedure) and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: list_result_shape
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_result('public.concierge_conversations_v1(int)'::regprocedure) = 'TABLE(psid text, psid_short text, guest_name text, updated_at timestamp with time zone, last_role text, last_text text, last_guest_at timestamp with time zone, open_handoffs integer, human_until timestamp with time zone, last_risk text)'

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261006_concierge_conversations.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the two functions. Nothing else changed. The Conversations page then shows its error state; roll the admin dashboard back too. The host-reply Edge Function can stay deployed: it only sends when a signed-in owner or admin taps Send.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_function_then_app
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release first, deploy the host-reply Edge Function second, publish the admin dashboard build with the Conversations page last: the page calls both RPCs on open and shows an error state until they exist, and its Send button posts to host-reply.

compatibility.rehearsal: PENDING - run on a restored backup together with the pgTAP suite concierge_conversations (22 assertions).
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only (2026-10-06): concierge_threads has columns psid, guest_name, human_until, bot_turns, history, last_risk, updated_at, booking_flow, last_mid, verified_until; concierge_handoffs has id, psid, guest_name, guest_text, risk, options, status, tg_message_id, resolved_by, resolved_at, sent_text, created_at. The list query body ran against production as a read-only SELECT (8 threads, 7 with a guest turn, every history an array, every entry role guest or bot). current_staff_active(text[]) exists and is the gate the concierge_handoffs read policy already uses.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the admin dashboard build is published before this release is applied
